name: fems
description: Fire Extinguisher Management System - TZW LTD

scripts.start: concurrently --names "GATEWAY,USERS,EXTINGUISHERS,REPORTS,NOTIFY,UI" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,blue,magenta,white" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:users" "npm run start:extinguishers" "npm run start:reports" "npm run start:notifications" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "GATEWAY,USERS,EXTINGUISHERS,REPORTS,NOTIFY" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:users" "npm run dev:extinguishers" "npm run dev:reports" "npm run dev:notifications"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd api-gateway && npm install && cd ../user-service && npm install && cd ../extinguisher-service && npm install && cd ../reporting-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
